services.name: Hud_PresentationEarlyPhaseNoOpHook
services.behavior: Returns immediately when the HUD presentation loop's frame phase is below 6 modulo 16; it does not read or modify state.

services.name: Hud_PresentationLatePhaseNoOpHook
services.behavior: Returns immediately for late presentation phases and the final post-loop hook call; it does not read or modify state.

evidence.caller: Hud_RunPendingDisplayPresentation at 0x001B0CBC calls 0x001B0134 when FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER & 0x0F is below 6, calls 0x001B0136 otherwise, and calls 0x001B0136 once after the loop.
evidence.bodies: Both entries contain only RTS and have no RAM reads, writes, callees, or outgoing references.

conclusion: The last two mechanically named runtime-observed functions are distinct phase-selected HUD presentation extension points, but both are currently inert in this ROM.
